name: 2-1-r27-split-spring-notes

movement.instructions: Apply the first matching rule: (1) enemy_dy < 0 AND enemy_dx <= 64: dodge_left. (2) grounded is true AND lowest_floor_drop_px == 0: run_right. (3) retreating is true AND drop_px < 32 AND lowest_floor_drop_px > 0: brake_left. (4) blocked is true AND wall_height > headroom: brake_left. Otherwise run_right. Null means absent; a comparison to null does not match.

criteria.dodge_left: Step left to avoid a nearby enemy falling from above.

enemy.instructions: Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and vertical_offset_px >= 0. Choose A if distance_px is null. Otherwise choose B.

enemy_low.instructions: Choose C if distance_px <= 40 and vertical_offset_px >= 0. Choose A if distance_px is null. Otherwise choose B.

wall.instructions: Choose A if distance_px is null. Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and (headroom_px is null OR height_px <= headroom_px). Otherwise choose B.

criteria.B: Do not jump at this wall.

pit.instructions: Choose A if distance_px is null. Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and floor_gaps is not empty. Otherwise choose B.

criteria.B: Not time to jump; far away or a safe drop.
criteria.C: Jump over the nearby floor gap.

air.instructions: Which direction is Mario moving vertically?

instructions: Choose one action. PRIORITY: if grounded and floor_gap_within_takeoff_distance is true, jump right. Otherwise if grounded and enemy_within_jump_distance is true, jump right. If grounded and wall_within_40px and wall_fits_headroom are both true, jump right. If rising, hold jump and run right. If falling, run right without jump. Otherwise run right without jump. Do not retreat from flying enemies: keep moving to the next platform. Follow active stage lessons.

criteria.right_run: Continue right without jump when falling or when no jump hazard is present.
criteria.right_run_jump: Jump right when grounded with a nearby hazard, or sustain a rising jump.

memory_notes.instructions: OVERRIDE: use a short hop over the goombas. Jump right only when grounded and enemy_within_jump_distance is true. Otherwise run right with jump released; do not sustain the jump.

criteria.right_run: Airborne or no nearby enemy: run right without jump.

memory_notes.instructions: OVERRIDE: wait beside the tall pipe until the plant retracts. Choose wait while note_elapsed_frames.pipe-wait is less than90. After that, jump right if grounded or rising, otherwise run right without jump.

criteria.right_run_jump: Elapsed >= 90 and grounded or rising: jump right.

memory_notes.instructions: OVERRIDE: land early before the next enemy. If rising hold jump and brake left. Otherwise run right without jump.
OVERRIDE: wait beside this tall pipe. Choose wait while note_elapsed_frames.second-pipe-wait is less than60. After that jump right if grounded or rising, otherwise run right.
OVERRIDE: use a short hop. If grounded jump right; otherwise release jump and run right.
OVERRIDE: jump early over these flying koopas. If grounded or rising jump right. If falling run right without jump.
OVERRIDE all earlier rules. If feet_y <48 or feet_y >240, choose right_run_jump to cross the wall. Otherwise choose right_run_jump. Hold jump throughout the springboard maneuver.

criteria.right_run_jump: Jump and move right toward or over the wall.
criteria.right_run: Release jump only for a grounded rearm.

memory_notes.instructions: OVERRIDE all earlier rules. If feet_y <48 or feet_y >240, choose right_run_jump to cross the wall. Otherwise choose jump. Hold jump throughout the springboard maneuver.

criteria.jump: Mario is below the wall top: feet_y is between48 and240 inclusive.
criteria.right_run_jump: Mario is above the wall top: feet_y is less than48 or greater than240.

memory_notes.instructions: OVERRIDE all earlier rules. If feet_y <48 or feet_y >240, choose right_run_jump to cross the wall. Otherwise choose left_jump. Hold jump throughout the springboard maneuver.

criteria.left_jump: Mario is below the wall top: feet_y is between48 and240 inclusive.
criteria.right_run_jump: Mario is above the wall top: feet_y is less than48 or greater than240.
